body.en: ICANN coordinates the internet's naming system. It does not regulate content and it does not run the internet: it coordinates who manages which names and numbers. Look at the map to see the whole ecosystem.
body.id: ICANN mengoordinasikan sistem penamaan internet. ICANN tidak mengatur konten dan tidak menjalankan internet. Mulailah dari peta untuk melihat gambaran besarnya.

body.en: The community (SOs and ACs) develops policy and advice, the Board adopts decisions, and ICANN org implements them. Keep these three apart and everything else falls into place.
body.id: Komunitas (SO dan AC) mengembangkan kebijakan dan nasihat, Dewan mengesahkan keputusan, organisasi ICANN menerapkannya.

body.en: Four committees advise the Board: ALAC (individual users), GAC (governments), SSAC (security), and RSSAC (root servers). Their advice is not binding.
body.id: Empat komite memberi nasihat kepada Dewan: ALAC (pengguna individu), GAC (pemerintah), SSAC (keamanan), dan RSSAC (root server). Nasihat mereka tidak mengikat.

body.en: The regional IP registries (RIRs), the IETF standards body, and the root server operators are independent organizations. ICANN coordinates with them; it does not run them.
body.id: RIR, IETF, dan operator root server bekerja mandiri di luar struktur ICANN. ICANN berkoordinasi dengan mereka, bukan mengendalikan.

body.en: A quick question before you move on.

question.en: Who develops policy recommendations for domains like .com?
question.id: Siapa yang mengembangkan rekomendasi kebijakan untuk domain seperti .com?

explanation.en: The GNSO is the Supporting Organization for generic top-level domains.
explanation.id: GNSO adalah SO yang menangani kebijakan gTLD.

body.en: Individual users join At-Large (ALAC). Businesses join the GNSO's commercial groups. Governments join the GAC. Technical people often start in the SSAC or via the IETF.
body.id: Pengguna individu masuk lewat At-Large (ALAC). Bisnis lewat GNSO. Pemerintah lewat GAC. Komunitas teknis biasanya lewat SSAC atau IETF.

body.en: For individuals in Indonesia the practical first step is APRALO, the Asia-Pacific regional At-Large organization. Join an existing At-Large Structure or start one.
body.id: Untuk Indonesia, pintu masuknya APRALO. Cari At-Large Structure lokal, atau daftarkan dirimu.

body.en: Working groups are where policy is actually written. GNSO working groups are open to anyone; you do not need to be a member of a constituency to join most of them.
body.id: Working group adalah tempat kebijakan dikerjakan. Sebagian besar terbuka untuk umum tanpa syarat keanggotaan.

body.en: ICANN holds public meetings during the year. First-timers can apply for the Fellowship or NextGen programs. Newcomer sessions on day one explain how everything works.
body.id: ICANN mengadakan pertemuan publik sepanjang tahun. Program Fellowship dan NextGen dirancang untuk peserta baru.

body.en: Week 1: pick your group and subscribe to its mailing list. Week 2: read the group's last three drafts. Week 3: comment in a public comment period. Week 4: introduce yourself on a call.
body.id: Minggu 1: pilih kelompokmu. Minggu 2: baca diskusi terakhir. Minggu 3: tulis komentar di konsultasi publik. Minggu 4: perkenalkan diri di rapat.

audience.en: For people who want to influence policy
audience.id: Untuk yang mau memahami dan memengaruhi kebijakan

body.en: A Supporting Organization runs a Policy Development Process: a working group drafts recommendations, the SO council approves them, and the Board considers adopting them.
body.id: Working group menyusun rekomendasi, SO menyetujui, lalu Dewan mempertimbangkan.

body.en: The GAC issues formal advice. The Board usually follows it; when it does not on certain topics, the Bylaws set a special procedure.
body.id: Nasihat GAC tidak mengikat, tetapi ada prosedur khusus kalau Dewan tidak mengikutinya.

body.en: Nearly every policy decision has a public comment period. Anyone can submit. Comments that are specific and on time carry the most weight.
body.id: Setiap draf kebijakan dibuka untuk komentar publik. Semua orang boleh memberi masukan.

body.en: Pick one live public comment proceeding on icann.org and read the comments. This is the fastest way to see how the process works.
body.id: Pilih satu isu yang sedang buka komentar publik di icann.org dan baca masukannya.

body.en: The internet has two coordinated registries: names (DNS) and numbers (IP addresses, ASNs). ICANN coordinates the first through the IANA functions; the RIR communities handle the second.
body.id: ICANN mengoordinasikan penamaan lewat fungsi IANA; alamat IP dikelola komunitas RIR secara mandiri.

body.en: The root zone lists all top-level domains. PTI (the IANA functions) manages it under ICANN; root server operators distribute it worldwide.
body.id: Zona root berisi daftar semua TLD, dikelola lewat fungsi IANA dan disebarkan operator root server.

body.en: The IETF develops protocol standards. IANA maintains the registries. ICANN hosts the IANA functions affiliate, but does not set technical standards.
body.id: IETF menetapkan standar; IANA menjaga registry-nya. Keduanya badan yang berbeda.

body.en: SSAC (security) and RSSAC (root servers) study risks and advise the Board. Start with their published reports.
body.id: SSAC dan RSSAC meneliti risiko keamanan dan stabilitas, hasilnya berupa laporan dan nasihat.
